description: $0.05 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one full observability readiness report for one submitted deployment sample: the verdict line and score under the published criteria, per-record-type status with evidence from your sample, and a concrete fix list. Submitted material is processed transiently and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the sample. It does not certify that an agent is safe.

config.description: Optional object: the deployment's framework/config description (key/value).

deployment_label.description: Optional short label for the deployment, echoed in the report.

framework.description: Optional label for the deployment's framework (descriptive only).

trace.description: Optional array of event objects: a sample trace/log the operator generated.

trace_text.description: Optional string: the sample trace as JSONL or raw log lines.

name: observability_report
